steps.name: lesson 6 example

java.steps:
s.start("Our wall, left corner tile, facing the field", -56, -61.1, 0)
 .run("Hold the piece", robot.claw::close)
 .move("To the goal", 24, 0, 0.6)
 .action(Actions.scoreHigh(robot), 5)
 .parkWithSeconds(3)
 .move("Park", 20, 90, 0.7);

steps.scenario:
# Score and Park: does the robot end where the plan says?
# Made by the crossbotics.com path builder (Simple steps). The plan is dead reckoning, so a
# real robot (and the simulator's) ends near it, not on it: within 4 in and 10 degrees here.
# Save it as simulator/scenarios/fixture.sim in your robot project, then from the ftc-helper-lib folder:
#   ./gradlew :sim:scenario -Pfile=../simulator/scenarios/fixture.sim
# The simulator's field numbers are seen from the RED wall. With mirrorForRed() false (BIOBUZZ), RED drives the numbers as written.
init "Score and Park"
press g1.b                             # RED
expect screen has "Place robot : Our wall, left corner tile, facing the field"   # the note at INIT
expect robot x = -56 0.5                # on the start spot
expect robot y = -61.1 0.5
start
expect within 32 screen has "Autonomous finished"
expect within 2 step 1 done            # Hold the piece
expect step 2 done                     # To the goal
expect step 3 done                     # Actions.scoreHigh(robot)
expect step 4 done                     # Park
expect robot x = -36 4
expect robot y = -37.1 4
expect robot heading = 0 10
expect error none

steps.name: goBILDA starter bot

java.steps:
s.start("Our wall, left corner tile, facing the field", -56, -62.95, 0)
 .run("Spin up", robot.launcher::spinUp)
 .move("Out from the wall", 20, 0, 0.6)
 .waitSeconds("Settle", 0.3)
 .turn("Face the HIVE", -45, 0.5)
 .action(Actions.fireAll(robot), 8)
 .parkWithSeconds(4)
 .turnTo("Square up", 0, 0.5)
 .move("Leave", 12, 0, 0.7);

steps.name: mirrored, no spot, alongside
steps.scenario:
# 2 piece: does the robot end where the plan says?
# Made by the crossbotics.com path builder (Simple steps). The plan is dead reckoning, so a
# real robot (and the simulator's) ends near it, not on it: within 4 in and 10 degrees here.
# Save it as simulator/scenarios/fixture.sim in your robot project, then from the ftc-helper-lib folder:
#   ./gradlew :sim:scenario -Pfile=../simulator/scenarios/fixture.sim
# The simulator's field numbers are seen from the RED wall. With mirrorForRed() true, RED drives the route mirrored: the numbers below are mirrored.
init "2 piece"
press g1.b                             # RED
expect screen has "Place robot : NEAR:"   # the note at INIT
set pose -30 -61.1 -90   # the code gives no spot: put the robot there
start
expect within 32 screen has "Autonomous finished"
expect within 2 step 1 done            # Actions.fireAll(robot)
expect step 2 done                     # Strafe out
expect step 3 done                     # Face "in"
expect step 4 done                     # Wait
expect step 5 done                     # Lift
expect step 6 done                     # Back
expect robot x = -28.1 4
expect robot y = -56.3 4
expect robot heading = -60 10
expect error none
